Feeder is a numerical identifier for electrical grid infrastructure, not a personal data identifier. It does not map to any personal data class in the ontology (e.g., PhysicalAddress, Location, IndividualProfile). It identifies a section of the power distribution network, not an individual. While it narrows a geographic area, it is a standard technical identifier used in grid management and does not directly or indirectly identify a natural person.

Substation is a numerical identifier for electrical grid infrastructure. Similar to feeder, it is a technical identifier for a power distribution node, not a personal data element. It does not correspond to any personal data class in the ontology. It is publicly known infrastructure information and does not identify any individual.

Date is a temporal reference point. By itself, it is not personal data and does not map to any personal data class in the ontology. While dates can be part of a data trail when combined with other identifiers, in this context it simply records when grid measurements were taken. It is a standard operational timestamp for infrastructure monitoring.
